question: The "Charter Act of 1833" made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Charter Act of 1833**, also known as the **Saint Helena Act 1833**, was an important legislative reform passed by the British Parliament to reorganize the administration of British territories in India.
 
• This Act **made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India**. It marked a significant administrative shift, centralizing power and authority over all British territories in India.
 
• **Lord William Bentinck** became the first Governor-General of India under the provisions of this Act, in the year **1833**.
 
• The Act gave the Governor-General of India exclusive legislative authority, leading to the abolition of the legislative powers of the **Governors of Bombay and Madras**.
